scope: Host-only recovery. No device connection, probing, staging, installation, restart, cleanup or privilege change. This document grants no approval.

payload.distribution: Preserve these local generated bytes. No rebuild performed. Do not execute historical installer or substitute bundle.tar.gz.

historical_only.warning: Not current device identity, release version, dependency compatibility or authority. Live values unknown. Historical prior native launch is not acceptance of 0.5.0.

approval_gates.approval: Separate bounded cable-connected read-only preflight, exact SSH host identity and approved metadata/hash inventory. No permission to install or restart. ADR 0001 grants no device access.

After reviewing preflight, approve frozen mutation manifest and executor digest, exact old link targets/inodes, old release hashes, target member pins, backup/stage paths and rollback bounds. Approve root SSH only if already configured; never enable Developer Mode or change privileges.
Save and close documents; approve one Xochitl restart if needed, separately from upgrade. No automatic restart or reboot.

approval_gates.owner: tablet owner and desktop owner via parent
approval_gates.approval: Observe native 0.5.0 pairing on real LAN, local desktop approval/revocation, bounded negative-access checks and client/service restart persistence. No later-ticket work.

preflight_requirements: Bind exact owner-confirmed cable endpoint and SSH host key; require strict host-key verification, no forwarding, no retries. No endpoint is assumed in this proposal.

Confirm current model, architecture, firmware IMG_VERSION and stock Xochitl hash match installer contract. Stop on mismatch; never upgrade/downgrade firmware. Confirm Developer Mode already enabled; explain factory reset/security impact rather than enable it.

Verify /home/root and every owned parent path are real directories with approved root ownership/modes and no symlink parents. Inventory XOVI xovi.so, appload.so and qt-resource-rebuilder.so hashes and installed dependency versions; compare against prior compatible evidence. Stop if unknown.

Inventory both launcher links with lstat, readlink and filesystem/device identity. Require both point to the same fully identified production release, with six regular verified payload files. Missing/mixed/foreign/regular-file launcher paths require a revised plan, not deletion.

Record private config.json, server-ca.pem, state.json existence, type, ownership, modes, sizes and hashes without printing values or tokens. Resolve configured StatePath/CA paths privately; preserve any external configured data too. Require compatible 0600 private files and unchanged device ID.

Desktop owner verifies intended stable server identity, HTTPS origin, certificate SHA-256 and certificate validity through trusted loopback output. Compare tablet saved trust privately with desktop trust. Record only public identity and digest. Unknown/mismatched identity or changed address requires a separate trust/repair decision; never replace config or CA silently.

Inventory all existing release files and old experiment paths using a fixed owner-approved inventory, without reading private document contents. Record path/type/hash metadata sufficient for preservation postcheck. Cover client drafts, cache and any external StatePath; never assume all user data resides in base.

Check free home space for complete backup and target, process quiescence, owner-saved documents, required command support including exclusive creation, sha256sum, unzip -p, readlink, stat, cmp, ln and mv -T. Prove same-filesystem rename support on approved scratch paths only after staging approval.

Choose fresh absent root-private backup/stage directories under owned home. Freeze literal paths only after occupied-path checks; this proposal deliberately contains no runnable commands with unknown live values.
upgrade_route: Use the reviewed manual release/link-switch route, not generic reinstallation. production-install.sh requires two digests and deliberately rejects different-release occupied links before writing. Its install-client subcommand has no --upgrade or --replace flag. Do not unlink existing launchers to trick the installer.

Before any mutation, parent freezes a new exact execution manifest from approved preflight. Bind current old release, both old link strings/inodes, preserved data hashes, stage/backup paths, all public payload pins, target release and executor hash. Revalidate immediately before write under owner-exclusive operation. Any difference stops.

With client closed and no data writer, create backup/stage exclusively with mode 0700 on home partition. Copy private files and configured external data/drafts with restricted original modes; preserve symlinks as symlinks, never follow an unexpected link. Verify backup hashes/modes. Keep backup on tablet, not in logs or repository. Snapshot desktop service state separately if needed for acceptance rollback.

Copy exactly the pinned client.zip and production-install.sh into the new private stage, verify both SHA-256 before extraction. The installer is retained for provenance only and is not executed on this manual route. No download of server.json and no rewriting tablet trust/config/state is needed.

Extract exactly six pinned archive members with unzip -p into fresh hardcoded paths. Verify each member hash/size and regular-file type against payload.archive_members. Set directories 0700, pi-ink-client and app/backend/entry 0700, other four payload files 0600. Verify version 0.5.0 and AArch64 executable; no user content reads.

If target release is absent, rename complete payload directory to exact target release on the same filesystem. If already present, require every expected file/type/hash/mode to match and no foreign contents; reuse without overwriting. Otherwise stop. Preserve old release and all old experiment files.

Stage two new symlinks outside launcher discovery directories, pointing to target release/app and target release/sidebar.qmd. Record originals in durable journal before first switch. Immediately before each mv -T rename, compare live link identity and literal target with frozen preflight. Replace only the two owned links via same-filesystem rename. Each rename is atomic; the pair is not atomic. Do not launch between switches.

Postcheck both new link targets and every target payload hash. Compare all preflight private/data/draft/unrelated inventories against originals and backups without printing secrets. Assert old release unchanged and no duplicate sidebar entries. Keep staging and backup; no cleanup is approved.

On any write/postcheck failure, stop, retain journal and partial state, prohibit launch/restart. Do not retry installer or broaden repair. Apply only the separately approved, identity-checked rollback below. Upgrade success authorizes neither restart nor acceptance.
rollback: Before launch/restart, restore only links already changed and still matching the exact new targets/inodes recorded by this execution. Stage original literal symlinks privately, verify old release hashes, rename each back with mv -T. Do not clobber an unexpected third-party change. Preserve both releases, all stages, backups and journal.
If one link switch fails, leave client closed and record mixed-link state. If rollback is not explicitly approved or any link/release identity changed, stop for owner decision instead of improvising.

After launch/acceptance, close client and obtain separate restart/rollback approval. Revalidate data compatibility and changed state before switching back. Never restore an old state.json automatically: that can resurrect credentials or overwrite new drafts.

Server revocation is authoritative. Do not restore desktop device database or tablet tokens to undo revocation. Any future re-pairing needs fresh explicit approval. Private backup restoration requires a new bounded conflict/preservation plan.

acceptance_sequence.future_owner_check: Record actual live model/firmware, XOVI/AppLoad versions/hashes, installed archive identity and upgrade preservation postcheck. Observe native sidebar opening 0.5.0 after separately approved restart. Host emulator screenshots do not count.

Use only manual server entry and trusted desktop fingerprint. Wrong fingerprint and wrong server must fail without changing saved trust/credential. Correct fingerprint verifies installed certificate and hostname over real LAN HTTPS. Do not weaken TLS or open firewall ports.

Through protected diagnostic image operation, prove unpaired/pending/denied/expired devices cannot retrieve image bytes. Open two-minute pairing window locally; native tablet and loopback desktop show same code. Explicit desktop approval issues credential only afterward; bounded failures stop after ten attempts. Use fresh isolated acceptance identities for destructive negative cases, not personal drafts.

Native client downloads, fully decodes and displays protected diagnostic PNG over verified HTTPS and opens authenticated outbound WSS on real LAN. Record public image digest and native screen; no inbox, dispatch or drawing acceptance is inferred.

With explicit restart permission, close/reopen AppLoad backend and restart desktop service independently. Confirm same server/device identity and approved pairing persist without new approval. Hash/mode-check private state without logging tokens; preserve drafts.

Use isolated real-service protocol probe to demonstrate unsupported tablet/extension protocol rejection without deleting pairing or stored work. Native supported client must reconnect afterward. Label protocol-probe evidence separately from native screen evidence.

Keep native outbound WSS active; revoke from trusted loopback management. Observe active connection closure on tablet and prove subsequent HTTPS diagnostic image and WSS attempts rejected, including after client/service restart. Display status alone is insufficient.

Prove management mutations reject LAN source, unexpected Host/Origin and cross-site/CSRF requests; local approved forms still work. Capture request outcomes without secrets. Mark each ticket criterion native/host/probe/unverified explicitly. Parent decides readiness for independent review; ticket remains claimed until then.

stop_conditions: No current owner approval at relevant gate
Live identity, firmware, dependency, trust or old-release mismatch
Unexpected/occupied/symlink path or changed link identity
Any failed operation; no automatic retry
Pairing/security acceptance failure; preserve artifacts and report

missing_capability.reason: Manual hash-pinned immutable release staging plus two guarded link renames is possible without changing product behavior. Existing installer is NOT an upgrade executor.
missing_capability.execution_prerequisite: A separately reviewed bounded executor and exact live-bound mutation/rollback manifest are not supplied or authorized here. Parent must obtain preflight and owner approvals before creating/executing them.
missing_capability.bounded_validation_proposal: Validate executor in disposable host filesystem: occupied/foreign link and changed-identity stop, same-version reuse, payload corruption stop before publish, second-link failure and approved rollback, private data/drafts unchanged, no overwrites of unrelated paths. Never relax production installer guards.

host_proof.new: Archive digest, exact six safe non-symlink members, VERSION 0.5.0, ELF AArch64 and source manifest/entry/sidebar byte equality verified locally; installer digest matches. go run . install-client --help listed only archive-sha256, source and server, exiting 1 with flag: help requested. No install executed. Fresh w72:p4 session is the fixed launcher live smoke.
